authors.description: Known authors, compilers, editors, or credited problem authors named by this source.

origin.description: Original contest, publication, or problem context represented by the source.

country.description: Country or state-level origin of a non-Russian source when this is explicit.

region.description: Region for sources that are broader than one country, for example international contests.

source_family.description: Optional normalized source family key used by the viewer.

attribution_status.description: Editorial status for uncertain eponyms or author attribution, for example needs_primary_source.
